compute_lpips_alex: compute LPIPS perceptual similarity between predicted and target images using the AlexNet base network
compute_lpips_vgg: compute LPIPS perceptual similarity between predicted and target images using the VGG base network
compute_lpips_squeeze: compute LPIPS perceptual similarity between predicted and target images using the SqueezeNet base network
compute_lpips_no_calibration: compute LPIPS without linear calibration by averaging features across model layers equally
compute_lpips_normalized: compute LPIPS on images in the 0 to 1 range by enabling input normalization
